Track 5, milestone 5. Adds `research/simdesign-dfm`: the parametric L-bracket sized for minimum mass with and without FDM, CNC-routing, laser-cutting and sand-casting rules, same material in each pair. Results (stylised, assumed rule values): casting +43% (even-section rule), CNC +24% (plate stock), laser and FDM about nothing; chosen designs exceed the stress limit by 17-26% on a fine mesh. 12 tests, README, `site/projects.json` and `python site/build.py` ok.
